companyFieldUpdates.description: Smarte Carte provides self-service luggage carts, electronic lockers, strollers, mobility services, and related passenger services in airports and other high-traffic venues. Its customer base is concentrated in travel, leisure, and public-venue operators that outsource essential passenger equipment and related services. The company combines an asset-heavy fleet of owned equipment with contracted concession and service arrangements across airports and other locations. Public materials describe more than 140,000 owned units and operations in more than 3,400 locations worldwide. The business has broadened its service offering through acquisitions and contract wins, including Aviation Mobility in 2018, Heathrow trolley operations in 2024, and Lost and Found Software in 2026. 3i invested alongside management in 2017 and continues to hold Smarte Group as a proprietary-capital infrastructure investment; the ownership split is not publicly disclosed.
